newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal cement consumption up 25 pct yr/yr June.
newsitem.headline: Portugal cement consumption up 25 pct yr/yr June.

text.p: Consumption of cement in Portugal in June rose to a record level of 831,000 tonnes, 25 percent more than in June 1996, the Association of Construction and Public Works Companies (AECOPS) said.

"The 831,000 tonnes of cement that AECOPS estimates were consumed in June represent an all-time high for consumption as compared with June in previous years, and the year-on-year increase was 25 percent," a statement said.
Consumption of cement in the first six months of 1997 grew by 20.5 percent year-on-year to 4.723 million tonnes, AECOPS said.
